response.sql: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), average_rate AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM media_rates) SELECT mr.Name, mr.rate, mr.track_count, mr.rate - ar.rate AS above_average FROM media_rates AS mr CROSS JOIN average_rate AS ar WHERE mr.rate > ar.rate;
